🌍 Iran’s National Post Company wins Asia-Pacific Postal Union Innovation Award

📌 Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s National Post Company has won the Innovation Award at the fourth Postal Business Forum of the Asia-Pacific Postal Union (APPU) in Thailand for innovative services supporting the Tehran Virtual Book Fair.

According to a press release issued by Iran’s Ministry of Information and Communications Technology on Wednesday, the award recognized the National Post Company for presenting postal solutions used to deliver books purchased through the virtual fair and for their contribution to expanding cultural access nationwide.
​
The postal network enabled readers across Iran to receive books efficiently by simplifying ordering, distribution and delivery.
​
The initiative demonstrated how postal logistics can support cultural events while improving equitable access to cultural services.
​
Iran Post has received an award or certificate of appreciation at the APPU’s business gathering for the third consecutive year, highlighting its focus on innovation.
​
The forum brought together representatives from countries to exchange experiences and examine digital transformation, smart logistics, e-commerce and postal services.
